purpose: Sealed diagnostic visualization only, no model training, new simulation, model selection or threshold tuning.
representation: Actual continuous interaction encoder output:3 object tokens+scene token,4x64 flattened256. Frozen v1 interaction seed0; identical non-transition parameters in repaired model. AE seed0 separate contextual comparison. Not query probabilities or raw DINO.
main_candidates: Only actual before/after indices in recorded skill pairs with existing9-column ground-truth labels. No moving interior windows. Ground truth only used for colour/hover and post-hoc diagnostics, never fitted to representation/PCA/tSNE or sample selection.

sampling.order: SHA256 of tsne20261016:<batch>:<state index>, independent of labels and embedding
sampling.exact_dedup: hash raw RGB and robot arrays; one actual representative, original IDs retained
sampling.near_dedup: within same root, both-camera mean absolute RGB difference/255 <=0.005 and max absolute difference of15 proprio entries <=0.005; keep first hash-ordered actual state; no averaging

main_preprocess.standardization: mean/std fitted to selected AB training states only, std floor1e-6, separately for each encoder
main_preprocess.PCA_fit: all selected unlabeled points, full SVD; only diagnostic transductive coordinates

stability: One prespecified alternative perplexity15, same seed42 and all preprocessing/points; keep both, never select prettier one. Compare10-neighbour overlap.
joint: D2 same selected pairs: actual successor, sealed control seed0 predicted successor, sealed matched seed0 predicted successor jointly fit once. Reuse main interaction AB scaling; PCA50 fitted unlabeled union.
joint_sampling: Each of12 roots:held_closed,held_open,empty_open for even root ordinal else empty_closed; reference slot ordinal modulo planned reference length, omit unavailable endpoint and record omission. No outcome-driven replacement.
paired_lines: Six predetermined pair IDs:held_closed on red_0/blue_0/pink_0 and held_open on red_1/blue_1/pink_1, two prediction-to-actual lines each.
environment: A/B/C/D are actual CALVIN physical scene domains. D2 uses scene D, distinct used-test sampling batch only. Models share robot/cameras; appearances and scene geometry can differ.
outputs: offline Plotly HTML with click-to-RGB and truth/query text
